_about: Growth engines (stage 3 of the Durand/CAP review). Segment revenue from each company's latest report: 'now' = latest period, 'year_ago' = same period a year earlier ($M). The model splits TTM revenue by the 'now' shares; each segment's year-1 growth = company scenario g1 x (segment growth / company growth), capped at cap_multiple x company g1, then shifted so the revenue-weighted year-1 growth equals the scenario g1 exactly. Every segment fades to the scenario g10 by year 10, then to 2.5% over the advantage period. The company margin is unchanged (one consolidated margin).

AAPL.period: Nine months to 27 Jun 2026 vs 28 Jun 2025

MSFT.period: Quarter to 30 Sep 2026 (FY27 Q1), year-ago recast from the stated growth (25%, -3%)

GOOGL.period: Quarter to 30 Sep 2026 vs 30 Sep 2025 (hedging gains excluded)
